exclusion_scope: Current manuscript figures, active datasets, future training/validation/testing and batch inference. Historical artifacts remain traceable.
tube_id_rule: Remove the last hyphen-separated position suffix from the canonical ID; Q1-1-Z2 belongs to Q1-1.
temporal_group_rule: All observed dates from one position stay in the same train/validation/test partition. Prefer complete tubes as groups for new cross-tube evaluations.
missing_periods: Keep missing dates absent; never replace a missing image with zeros or another date.
corrected_position_quality: Q1-1-Z2 retains the latest root-band candidate localization; the T2-to-T3 link remains coarse/unverified. Renaming does not improve its registration quality.
